purpose: Audit compatibility decisions with complete supplied contract context

requirements.evidence: The handoff retains legacy_code for the current client, queued jobs, mixed deployment, and rollback, and explicitly rejects publication status as the deciding criterion.
The handoff excludes code_old because no current consumer or persisted use is known and says that newly found usage would require revisiting the decision.
It sets client, queue, mixed-version, rollback, and usage-observation conditions for retirement and maps both input forms and later removal to checks without editing files.

results.evidence: All three compatibility boundaries were observable in the read-only implementation handoff.

stopping_reason: The selected current-versus-obsolete compatibility case answered the Issue #37 acceptance question.
unverified: Other evaluation cases and routing were not rerun; real application repositories and other clients remain untested.
